from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank, returns
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _sector_returns(ret: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal equal-weighted same-sector return, formed independently each bar."""
    out = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns, dtype=float)
    labels = sector.reindex(index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns).ffill()
    for timestamp in ret.index:
        row_ret = ret.loc[timestamp]
        row_labels = labels.loc[timestamp]
        valid = row_ret.notna() & row_labels.notna()
        if valid.any():
            means = row_ret[valid].groupby(row_labels[valid]).mean()
            out.loc[timestamp, valid] = row_labels[valid].map(means).astype(float)
    return out


def _excess_tail_beta(stock_ret: pd.DataFrame, sector_ret: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Trailing downside-sector beta in excess of ordinary beta."""
    window = 60
    x_mean = sector_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=window).mean()
    y_mean = stock_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=window).mean()
    xy_mean = (stock_ret * sector_ret).rolling(window, min_periods=window).mean()
    x2_mean = (sector_ret * sector_ret).rolling(window, min_periods=window).mean()
    ordinary = (xy_mean - x_mean * y_mean) / (x2_mean - x_mean * x_mean).replace(0.0, np.nan)

    cutoff = sector_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=window).quantile(0.20)
    tail = sector_ret.le(cutoff) & sector_ret.lt(0.0)
    count = tail.astype(float).rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
    mx = sector_ret.where(tail)
    my = stock_ret.where(tail)
    tx = mx.rolling(window, min_periods=1).sum() / count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    ty = my.rolling(window, min_periods=1).sum() / count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    txy = (mx * my).rolling(window, min_periods=1).sum() / count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    tx2 = (mx * mx).rolling(window, min_periods=1).sum() / count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    tail_beta = (txy - tx * ty) / (tx2 - tx * tx).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return (tail_beta - ordinary).where(count >= 8.0)


def _zscore(values: pd.DataFrame, window: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    mean = values.rolling(window, min_periods=window).mean()
    std = values.rolling(window, min_periods=window).std().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return ((values - mean) / std).clip(lower=-5.0, upper=5.0)


def _fragility(cash_ratio: pd.DataFrame, debt_to_equity: pd.DataFrame, interest_coverage: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    cash = cash_ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).clip(lower=0.0)
    debt = debt_to_equity.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).clip(lower=0.0)
    coverage = interest_coverage.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).clip(lower=0.0)
    return ((1.0 - rank(cash)) + rank(debt) + (1.0 - rank(coverage))) / 3.0


@register_factor
class FragileTailBacklogCompletionWickReversal(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "fragile_tail_backlog_completion_wick_reversal"
    name = "Fragile Tail Backlog Completion Reversal"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Longs recovered downside liquidity probes in fragile, sector-tail-exposed names "
        "only when a previously elevated delayed-volume sell backlog is decelerating."
    )
    window_length = 60
    inputs = [
        "open", "high", "low", "close", "volume", "sector", "cashRatio",
        "debtToEquity", "interestCoverage"
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        open_ = data["open"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        high = data["high"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        low = data["low"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        close = data["close"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        volume = data["volume"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        ret = returns(data).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        safe_open = open_.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        bar_range = (high - low).clip(lower=0.0).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        downside = ((safe_open - low).clip(lower=0.0) / safe_open).clip(upper=0.25)
        recovery = ((close - low).clip(lower=0.0) / (safe_open - low).replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.0, 1.0)
        close_location = ((close - low).clip(lower=0.0) / bar_range).clip(0.0, 1.0)
        normal_range = ((high - low).clip(lower=0.0) / safe_open).rolling(20, min_periods=10).median().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        abnormal_probe = downside / normal_range
        volume_base = volume.rolling(20, min_periods=10).median().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        participation = np.log1p((volume / volume_base).clip(lower=0.0, upper=5.0))
        wick_absorption = abnormal_probe * (0.5 * recovery + 0.5 * close_location) * participation

        previous_close = close.shift(1).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        weak_close = ((high - close).clip(lower=0.0) / bar_range).clip(0.0, 1.0)
        unresolved_downside = ((previous_close - low).clip(lower=0.0) / previous_close).clip(0.0, 0.25) * weak_close
        downside_z = _zscore(unresolved_downside, 15).fillna(0.0)
        volume_z = _zscore(np.log1p(volume.clip(lower=0.0)), 15).fillna(0.0)
        delayed = (volume_z * downside_z.shift(2)).rolling(8, min_periods=8).mean()
        concurrent = (volume_z * downside_z).rolling(8, min_periods=8).mean()
        backlog = (delayed - concurrent).clip(lower=0.0).fillna(0.0)
        completion = (backlog.shift(2) * (backlog.shift(2) - backlog).clip(lower=0.0)).clip(upper=10.0)

        sector_ret = _sector_returns(ret, data["sector"])
        excess_tail = _excess_tail_beta(ret, sector_ret).clip(lower=0.0).fillna(0.0)
        sector_vol = sector_ret.rolling(20, min_periods=10).std().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        sector_stress = ((-sector_ret) / sector_vol).clip(lower=0.0, upper=4.0).fillna(0.0)
        fragility = _fragility(data["cashRatio"], data["debtToEquity"], data["interestCoverage"]).fillna(0.5)

        signal = wick_absorption * (1.0 + excess_tail) * fragility * sector_stress * completion
        return rank(signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)).fillna(0.0).reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns).astype(float)
programs.name: Fragile Tail Backlog Completion Reversal
programs.trading_idea: A recovered intraday downside probe is most informative when it occurs in a financially fragile name with elevated sector-downside exposure, because those names are more likely to have faced genuine forced selling rather than random intraday noise. The child requires evidence that the prior delayed-volume liquidation backlog is now cooling, turning Parent B's continuation state into an execution-completion clock and Parent A's wick into direct evidence that residual supply has been absorbed. Parent A alone cannot distinguish a terminal absorption from a still-active sell program, while Parent B alone is directionally bearish during an unresolved backlog and misses the reversal created when that backlog decays into a high-participation recovery.
programs.description: Ranks recovered, abnormal-volume downside excursions after conditioning them on financial fragility, excess sector downside-tail beta, current sector stress, and a recently elevated but decelerating delayed-volume backlog. High values identify likely terminal forced-sale absorption and predict positive six-bar returns.

"""Scheduled participation close pressure.

Mechanism: persistent closes near a bar endpoint under regular volume participation
proxy for a sliced parent order.  Execution algorithms distribute residual
inventory across sessions, so directional pressure can persist beyond the
current bar; irregular volume is downweighted as it is more consistent with a
one-off event or forced liquidity demand.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor

def _bar_extremes(open_: pd.DataFrame, high: pd.DataFrame, low: pd.DataFrame, close: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Causally sanitize OHLC extrema without using information beyond a bar."""
    safe_open = open_.fillna(close)
    safe_high = high.fillna(close)
    safe_low = low.fillna(close)
    bar_high = safe_high.combine(safe_open, np.maximum).combine(close, np.maximum)
    bar_low = safe_low.combine(safe_open, np.minimum).combine(close, np.minimum)
    return (bar_high, bar_low)

def _participation_regularity(volume: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Inverse trailing coefficient of variation of relative participation.

    A high value denotes stable, schedule-like volume rather than a single
    exceptional print.  Every statistic is computed on trailing observations.
    """
    baseline = volume.rolling(20, min_periods=10).mean().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    participation = volume / baseline
    mean_participation = participation.rolling(10, min_periods=10).mean()
    std_participation = participation.rolling(10, min_periods=10).std()
    cv = std_participation / mean_participation.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return 1.0 / (1.0 + cv.clip(lower=0.0))

@register_factor
class ScheduledParticipationClosePressure(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = 'scheduled_participation_close_pressure_1'
    name = 'Scheduled Participation Close Pressure'
    category = 'microstructure'
    description = 'Ranks persistent signed close-location pressure, volume-scaled and downweighted when trailing participation is irregular; high values proxy for a continuing buy execution schedule.'
    window_length = 20
    inputs = ['open', 'high', 'low', 'close', 'volume']
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        open_ = data['open']
        high = data['high']
        low = data['low']
        close = data['close']
        volume = data['volume'].fillna(0.0).clip(lower=0.0)
        bar_high, bar_low = _bar_extremes(open_, high, low, close)
        bar_range = (bar_high - bar_low).where(lambda x: x > 1e-12)
        close_location = ((2.0 * close - bar_high - bar_low) / bar_range).clip(lower=-1.0, upper=1.0)
        volume_base = volume.rolling(20, min_periods=10).mean().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        relative_volume = (volume / volume_base).clip(lower=0.0)
        signed_pressure = close_location * np.sqrt(relative_volume)
        persistent_pressure = signed_pressure.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
        regularity = _participation_regularity(volume)
        score = persistent_pressure * regularity
        return rank(score).fillna(0.5)
programs.name: Scheduled Participation Close Pressure
programs.trading_idea: A sequence of bars closing persistently near one end of their ranges while volume participation is unusually regular is a daily-bar proxy for an execution algorithm working a parent order rather than a one-off liquidity shock. Regular participation implies that the order is being sliced to reduce footprint, so its residual inventory is likely to continue exerting directional pressure over the next several sessions. This is falsifiable: the signal should predict six-day returns after controlling for recent returns and raw relative volume, and should fail or reverse when volume participation is irregular, as would be expected for information shocks or forced liquidations. The edge can persist because the underlying metaorder schedule and remaining inventory are not directly observable from daily bars, while execution desks deliberately trade slowly rather than immediately arbitraging their own price impact.
programs.description: Computes signed close-location pressure scaled by relative volume, averages it over recent bars, and weights it by the regularity of recent volume participation. High positive values indicate a likely buy program being executed steadily; negative values indicate an analogous sell program.

programs.code:
"""Peer-validated auction states condition recurring metaorder pressure.

Mechanism: a phase-locked signed-volume program is more credible when a recent
partially refilled opening auction remains accepted and is independently
confirmed by leave-one-out industry flow.  Low impact then indicates that
passive depth is still absorbing the scheduled order, leaving continuation.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _leave_one_out_industry_return(
    ret: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
    industry: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal volume-weighted leave-one-out industry return."""
    peer = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns, dtype=float)
    if industry.empty:
        return peer
    labels = industry.iloc[0]
    safe_volume = volume.fillna(0.0).clip(lower=0.0)

    for label in pd.unique(labels.dropna()):
        members = labels.index[labels == label]
        if len(members) < 2:
            continue
        group_ret = ret.loc[:, members]
        weights = safe_volume.loc[:, members].where(group_ret.notna(), 0.0)
        total_weight = weights.sum(axis=1)
        total_return = (group_ret.fillna(0.0) * weights).sum(axis=1)
        for ticker in members:
            own_weight = weights[ticker]
            own_return = group_ret[ticker].fillna(0.0) * own_weight
            peer[ticker] = (total_return - own_return) / (
                total_weight - own_weight
            ).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return peer


def _phase_persistence(
    pressure: pd.DataFrame,
    lag: int = 5,
    cycles: int = 10,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Historical same-weekday coherence and current renewal, trailing only."""
    signed_history = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=pressure.index, columns=pressure.columns)
    absolute_history = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=pressure.index, columns=pressure.columns)
    for cycle in range(1, cycles + 1):
        delayed = pressure.shift(lag * cycle)
        signed_history = signed_history + delayed.fillna(0.0)
        absolute_history = absolute_history + delayed.abs().fillna(0.0)

    coherence = signed_history.abs() / absolute_history.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    coherence = coherence.clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
    historical_scale = absolute_history / float(cycles)
    renewal = pressure.abs() / historical_scale.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    renewal = renewal.clip(lower=0.0, upper=4.0)

    phase_corr = pressure.rolling(lag * cycles, min_periods=lag * 6).corr(
        pressure.shift(lag)
    )
    agreement = (
        np.sign(pressure) * np.sign(signed_history)
    ).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
    persistence = coherence * phase_corr.clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0) * agreement
    return persistence, renewal


def _auction_peer_state(
    open_price: pd.DataFrame,
    close: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
    peer_return: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """State at t from yesterday's auction and its one-day retained direction."""
    prior_close = close.shift(1).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    gap = (open_price - prior_close) / prior_close
    intraday = (close - open_price) / open_price.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    refill = (-intraday / gap.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)

    volume_base = volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=10).mean().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    activity = np.log1p((volume / volume_base).clip(lower=0.0, upper=8.0))
    activity = (activity / np.log(3.0)).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)

    event_gap = gap.shift(1)
    event_refill = refill.shift(1)
    event_activity = activity.shift(1)
    event_reference = prior_close.shift(1)
    event_direction = np.sign(event_gap)
    retained = event_direction * (close / event_reference - 1.0)
    retention = (retained / event_gap.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(
        lower=0.0, upper=1.0
    )
    peer_confirmed = (np.sign(peer_return) == event_direction).astype(float)
    peer_confirmed = peer_confirmed.where(
        peer_return.notna() & event_gap.notna(), 0.0
    )
    return (event_refill * event_activity * retention * peer_confirmed).clip(
        lower=0.0, upper=1.0
    )


@register_factor
class PeerValidatedPhasePressureHandoff(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "peer_validated_phase_pressure_handoff"
    name = "Peer-Validated Phase Pressure Handoff"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Signed recurring five-day volume pressure, gated by a retained prior "
        "auction whose direction is confirmed by leave-one-out industry flow, "
        "and weighted toward unusually low-impact execution."
    )
    window_length = 70
    inputs = ["open", "close", "volume", "industry"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].replace(0.0, np.nan)
        open_price = data["open"].replace(0.0, np.nan)
        volume = data["volume"].fillna(0.0).clip(lower=0.0)
        ret = close.pct_change().replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        log_volume = np.log1p(volume)
        volume_norm = log_volume / log_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=10).mean().replace(
            0.0, np.nan
        )
        bar_direction = np.sign((close - open_price).fillna(0.0))
        pressure = (bar_direction * volume_norm).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)

        persistence, renewal = _phase_persistence(pressure)
        peer_return = _leave_one_out_industry_return(ret, volume, data["industry"])
        auction_state = _auction_peer_state(open_price, close, volume, peer_return)

        impact = (ret.abs() / volume_norm.replace(0.0, np.nan)).replace(
            [np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan
        )
        impact_base = impact.rolling(60, min_periods=30).mean().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        relative_impact = impact / impact_base
        depth_weight = 1.0 / (1.0 + relative_impact.clip(lower=0.0, upper=10.0))

        signal = pressure * renewal * persistence * auction_state * depth_weight
        valid = persistence.notna() & auction_state.notna() & impact_base.notna()
        signal = signal.where(valid, np.nan).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        return signal.rank(axis=1, pct=True).fillna(0.5).reindex(
            index=close.index, columns=close.columns
        )
programs.name: Peer-Validated Phase Pressure Handoff
programs.trading_idea: A recurring same-sign volume-pressure schedule is more likely to represent an unfinished informed metaorder when a recent partially refilled opening auction is independently validated by contemporaneous leave-one-out industry flow. The auction/peer state separates broad correlated demand or supply from idiosyncratic bar noise, while phase recurrence identifies that the flow is persistent rather than a one-off industry reaction. Low realized impact indicates replenishing passive liquidity, so the combination identifies names where externally validated flow is still being transferred from the auction into a scheduled execution program and should continue over the next six bars.
programs.description: Ranks signed, renewed five-day phase-locked volume pressure only after a retained prior-auction gap agrees with leave-one-out industry flow and the stock displays below-normal price impact. The signal is positive for buy-program handoffs and negative for sell-program handoffs.

"""Auction repair completion conditioned on concave price impact.

Mechanism: a repaired opening auction can reverse only after the associated
high-participation execution loses marginal price impact.  Concave signed
impact distinguishes completed mechanical repair flow from an active program
that is still consuming liquidity.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _repair_impact_concavity(
    repair_direction: pd.DataFrame,
    relative_volume: pd.DataFrame,
    returns: pd.DataFrame,
    volatility: pd.DataFrame,
    window: int = 5,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal local quadratic concavity of signed return against volume.

    Each estimate uses only the trailing window.  A positive output means that
    return accumulated in the current repair direction has diminishing marginal
    response to additional relative volume, consistent with execution completion.
    """
    direction_values = repair_direction.to_numpy(dtype=float, copy=False)
    volume_values = relative_volume.to_numpy(dtype=float, copy=False)
    return_values = returns.to_numpy(dtype=float, copy=False)
    volatility_values = volatility.to_numpy(dtype=float, copy=False)

    n_rows, n_cols = direction_values.shape
    output = np.zeros((n_rows, n_cols), dtype=float)

    for column in range(n_cols):
        for row in range(window - 1, n_rows):
            direction = direction_values[row, column]
            if not np.isfinite(direction) or direction == 0.0:
                continue

            start = row - window + 1
            local_volume = volume_values[start : row + 1, column]
            local_returns = return_values[start : row + 1, column]
            local_volatility = volatility_values[start : row + 1, column]
            if not (
                np.isfinite(local_volume).all()
                and np.isfinite(local_returns).all()
                and np.isfinite(local_volatility).all()
            ):
                continue

            total_volume = np.maximum(local_volume, 0.0).sum()
            scale = np.nanmedian(local_volatility)
            if total_volume <= 1.0e-10 or not np.isfinite(scale) or scale <= 1.0e-10:
                continue

            x = np.cumsum(np.maximum(local_volume, 0.0)) / total_volume
            y = np.cumsum(direction * local_returns / scale)
            design = np.column_stack((np.ones(window), x, x * x))
            if np.linalg.matrix_rank(design) < 3:
                continue

            try:
                coefficient = np.linalg.lstsq(design, y, rcond=None)[0][2]
            except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
                continue

            if np.isfinite(coefficient):
                output[row, column] = np.clip(-2.0 * coefficient, 0.0, 10.0)

    return pd.DataFrame(output, index=repair_direction.index, columns=repair_direction.columns)


@register_factor
class AuctionRepairConcaveImpactCompletion(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "auction_repair_concave_impact_completion"
    name = "Auction Repair Concave Impact Completion"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Reverses opening-gap repairs only when aligned high-participation "
        "pressure has diminishing marginal signed price impact, indicating "
        "completion of temporary auction-related execution."
    )
    window_length = 25
    inputs = ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        open_ = data["open"].astype(float)
        high = data["high"].astype(float)
        low = data["low"].astype(float)
        close = data["close"].astype(float)
        volume = data["volume"].astype(float).fillna(0.0).clip(lower=0.0)

        prior_close = close.shift(1).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        gap = np.log(open_.where(open_ > 0.0) / prior_close)
        gap_scale = gap.abs().rolling(20, min_periods=10).median().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        standardized_gap = (gap / gap_scale).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).clip(-5.0, 5.0)

        bar_high = pd.DataFrame(
            np.maximum(high.to_numpy(dtype=float), close.to_numpy(dtype=float)),
            index=close.index,
            columns=close.columns,
        )
        bar_low = pd.DataFrame(
            np.minimum(low.to_numpy(dtype=float), close.to_numpy(dtype=float)),
            index=close.index,
            columns=close.columns,
        )
        bar_range = (bar_high - bar_low).where(lambda frame: frame > 1.0e-12)
        location = ((2.0 * close - bar_high - bar_low) / bar_range).clip(-1.0, 1.0)
        location = location.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)

        gap_direction = np.sign(standardized_gap).fillna(0.0)
        rejection = (1.0 - gap_direction * location) / 2.0
        repair = (-standardized_gap * rejection).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
        repair_direction = np.sign(repair)

        normal_volume = volume.rolling(20, min_periods=10).median().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        relative_volume = (volume / normal_volume).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        relative_volume = relative_volume.clip(0.0, 5.0).fillna(0.0)
        participation = np.log(relative_volume.where(relative_volume > 0.0))
        participation = participation.clip(0.0, np.log(4.0)).fillna(0.0)

        endpoint_pressure = location * participation
        persistent_pressure = endpoint_pressure.rolling(4, min_periods=3).mean().fillna(0.0)
        aligned_pressure = (repair_direction * persistent_pressure).clip(0.0, 2.0)

        returns = (close / prior_close - 1.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
        volatility = returns.rolling(20, min_periods=8).std().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        concavity = _repair_impact_concavity(
            repair_direction,
            relative_volume,
            returns,
            volatility,
        )

        signal = -repair_direction * repair.abs().clip(upper=5.0) * aligned_pressure * concavity
        signal = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
        return rank(signal).reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns).fillna(0.5)
programs.name: Auction Repair Concave Impact Completion
programs.trading_idea: An opening-gap repair accompanied by abnormal endpoint volume identifies a concentrated auction-related execution episode, but the repair is only likely exhausted when its price impact becomes concave: additional participation produces progressively less signed price movement. Parent B identifies the auction-repair state, while Parent A supplies the impact-shape diagnostic that separates an active, still-depleting program from a mechanically completed repair. The interaction has edge because a repaired gap with convex impact can still continue in the repair direction, whereas a high-participation repair with fading marginal impact is more likely to reverse back toward the original gap over the next week.
programs.description: The factor detects abnormal opening-gap repairs with persistent endpoint pressure in the repair direction, then weights the reversal signal by negative quadratic curvature of cumulative repair-direction return versus cumulative relative volume. It is positive for exhausted downward repairs expected to rebound and negative for exhausted upward repairs expected to fade.

programs.code:
"""Terminal release after saturated scheduled execution.

Mechanism: repeated same-phase signed participation identifies a likely mechanical
execution schedule.  When the current aligned participation fades after the
schedule has recently produced unusually high price impact, the programme is
likely near completion; the temporary inventory displacement should unwind over
the following week.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _terminal_phase_components(
    pressure: pd.DataFrame,
    impact: pd.DataFrame,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Causally estimate schedule direction, coherence, terminal fading, and impact stress."""
    lags = (5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40)
    phase_sum = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=pressure.index, columns=pressure.columns)
    phase_abs = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=pressure.index, columns=pressure.columns)

    for lag in lags:
        prior = pressure.shift(lag)
        phase_sum = phase_sum + prior.fillna(0.0)
        phase_abs = phase_abs + prior.abs().fillna(0.0)

    phase_direction = phase_sum / phase_abs.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    coherence = phase_direction.abs().clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
    prior_activity = phase_abs / float(len(lags))

    current_activity = pressure.abs()
    fading = (1.0 - current_activity / prior_activity.replace(0.0, np.nan))
    fading = fading.clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)

    recent_impact = impact.rolling(5, min_periods=3).mean()
    impact_baseline = impact.shift(5).rolling(40, min_periods=20).median()
    impact_stress = recent_impact / impact_baseline.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
    impact_stress = (impact_stress.clip(lower=0.0, upper=3.0) / 3.0)

    return phase_direction, coherence, prior_activity, fading * impact_stress


@register_factor
class PhaseTerminalSaturationReleaseV3(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "phase_terminal_saturation_release_v3"
    name = "Scheduled Flow Terminal Release"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Ranks the expected reversal after phase-coherent signed participation "
        "fades in a recently high-impact execution regime."
    )
    window_length = 65
    inputs = ["open", "close", "volume"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        open_price = data["open"]
        close = data["close"]
        volume = data["volume"].clip(lower=0.0)

        safe_open = open_price.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        bar_return = close / safe_open - 1.0
        direction = np.sign(bar_return.fillna(0.0))

        volume_base = volume.rolling(20, min_periods=15).mean()
        participation = volume / volume_base.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        participation = participation.clip(lower=0.0, upper=5.0)
        pressure = direction * participation

        impact = bar_return.abs() / participation.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        phase_direction, coherence, prior_activity, terminal_stress = _terminal_phase_components(
            pressure, impact
        )

        # The final observed bar must still point in the historical schedule's
        # direction; otherwise fading activity is not evidence of programme completion.
        aligned = (pressure * phase_direction > 0.0).astype(float)
        schedule_strength = (prior_activity.clip(lower=0.0, upper=3.0) / 3.0)

        # Oppose the historical schedule: negative scheduled pressure produces
        # a positive score when its terminal release implies a rebound.
        raw_signal = (
            -phase_direction
            * coherence
            * schedule_strength
            * terminal_stress
            * aligned
        )

        valid = (
            volume_base.notna()
            & phase_direction.notna()
            & terminal_stress.notna()
        )
        raw_signal = raw_signal.where(valid, np.nan).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        return raw_signal.rank(axis=1, pct=True).fillna(0.5)
programs.name: Scheduled Flow Terminal Release
programs.trading_idea: The parent report indicates that recurring signed-volume schedules are more reliably associated with a six-bar reversal than continuation. This child interprets a coherent weekly-phase flow pattern whose current participation is fading after unusually elevated price impact as a terminal execution state: a mechanical buyer or seller has consumed marginal liquidity and is nearing completion, leaving a temporary price displacement that subsequently releases in the opposite direction. The edge should persist because the remaining parent-order inventory and its completion timing are latent, while liquidity providers and short-horizon traders cannot distinguish a fading mechanical schedule from informed directional flow using a single daily bar. This is falsified if fading phase-aligned pressure with elevated recent impact continues in the direction of the historical schedule rather than reversing over the next six bars.

"""Scheduled metaorder continuation from regular participation and muted impact.

Mechanism: informed institutions commonly split a target trade into regular
participation slices. Persistent signed volume proxy with unusually stable slice
sizes but little contemporaneous price impact is evidence of an absorbed,
uncompleted execution program rather than a one-day opening reversal.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _latent_metaorder_score(
    open_: pd.DataFrame,
    high: pd.DataFrame,
    low: pd.DataFrame,
    close: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal proxy for an unfinished, regularly scheduled execution program.

    Close location supplies a signed-flow proxy. All normalizations use trailing
    windows only; no estimate at t uses a later bar.
    """
    safe_range = (high - low).where((high - low) > 1e-12)
    location = ((2.0 * close - high - low) / safe_range).clip(-1.0, 1.0)
    vol = volume.clip(lower=0.0)
    typical_vol = vol.rolling(20, min_periods=10).mean().where(lambda x: x > 0.0)
    participation = (vol / typical_vol).clip(lower=0.0, upper=5.0)
    signed_flow = location.fillna(0.0) * participation.fillna(0.0)

    directional_flow = signed_flow.rolling(8, min_periods=6).mean()
    flow_dispersion = signed_flow.rolling(8, min_periods=6).std()
    persistence = directional_flow.abs() / flow_dispersion.where(flow_dispersion > 1e-12)

    part_mean = participation.rolling(8, min_periods=6).mean()
    part_std = participation.rolling(8, min_periods=6).std()
    participation_cv = part_std / part_mean.where(part_mean > 1e-12)
    regularity = 1.0 / (1.0 + participation_cv.clip(lower=0.0))

    ret = close.pct_change()
    realized_impact = ret.abs().rolling(8, min_periods=6).mean()
    flow_activity = signed_flow.abs().rolling(8, min_periods=6).mean()
    impact_per_flow = realized_impact / flow_activity.where(flow_activity > 1e-12)
    impact_baseline = impact_per_flow.rolling(40, min_periods=15).median()
    absorption = impact_baseline / impact_per_flow.where(impact_per_flow > 1e-12)
    absorption = absorption.clip(lower=0.0, upper=3.0)

    return directional_flow * persistence.clip(upper=4.0) * regularity * absorption


@register_factor
class RegularParticipationLatentMetaorderDrift(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "regular_participation_latent_metaorder_drift"
    name = "Regular Participation Metaorder Drift"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Ranks persistent signed close-location flow when daily participation "
        "is regular and price impact per unit flow is muted, identifying likely "
        "unfinished institutional execution."
    )
    window_length = 40
    inputs = ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        score = _latent_metaorder_score(
            data["open"],
            data["high"],
            data["low"],
            data["close"],
            data["volume"],
        )
        return rank(score.fillna(0.0)).fillna(0.5)

"""Auction-repaired peer relay licensed by scheduled liquidity depletion.

Mechanism: an opening auction can temporarily mask a broad peer-information
impulse.  A repaired opposing gap becomes actionable only when a persistent,
aligned execution schedule encounters a freshly depleted thin side, indicating
that inventory absorption is ending and the peer signal can transmit.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _leave_one_out_peer_return(
    ret: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
    industry: pd.DataFrame,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Leave-one-out industry VW return and directional breadth, using same-bar data."""
    peer = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns, dtype=float)
    breadth = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns, dtype=float)
    labels = industry.iloc[0] if len(industry.index) else pd.Series(index=ret.columns, dtype=object)
    safe_volume = volume.clip(lower=0.0).fillna(0.0)
    valid = ret.notna()

    for label in pd.unique(labels.dropna()):
        members = labels.index[labels == label]
        if len(members) < 2:
            continue
        group_ret = ret.loc[:, members]
        group_valid = valid.loc[:, members]
        weights = safe_volume.loc[:, members].where(group_valid, 0.0)
        weighted_sum = (group_ret.fillna(0.0) * weights).sum(axis=1)
        total_weight = weights.sum(axis=1)
        sign_sum = np.sign(group_ret).where(group_valid, 0.0).sum(axis=1)
        count = group_valid.sum(axis=1).astype(float)

        for ticker in members:
            own_weight = weights[ticker]
            own_ret = group_ret[ticker].fillna(0.0)
            peer[ticker] = (weighted_sum - own_ret * own_weight) / (
                total_weight - own_weight
            ).replace(0.0, np.nan)
            own_sign = np.sign(group_ret[ticker]).where(group_valid[ticker], 0.0)
            breadth[ticker] = (sign_sum - own_sign).abs() / (
                count - group_valid[ticker].astype(float)
            ).replace(0.0, np.nan)

    return peer, breadth


def _auction_repair_gate(
    open_: pd.DataFrame,
    close: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
    peer: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Opposing auction displacement subsequently repaired in peer direction."""
    prior_close = close.shift(1).where(close.shift(1) > 0.0)
    gap = np.log(open_.where(open_ > 0.0) / prior_close)
    intraday = np.log(close.where(close > 0.0) / open_.where(open_ > 0.0))

    gap_scale = gap.rolling(20, min_periods=10).std().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    intra_scale = intraday.rolling(20, min_periods=10).std().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    opposing = (np.sign(peer) * gap < 0.0).astype(float)
    displacement = (gap.abs() / gap_scale).clip(lower=0.0, upper=3.0)
    repair = (np.sign(peer) * intraday / intra_scale).clip(lower=0.0, upper=3.0)

    log_volume = np.log1p(volume.clip(lower=0.0))
    vol_mean = log_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=10).mean()
    vol_std = log_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=10).std().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    ordinary_participation = np.exp(-((log_volume - vol_mean) / vol_std).abs())
    return displacement * repair * opposing * ordinary_participation.clip(0.0, 1.0)


def _schedule_coherence(residual: pd.DataFrame, relative_volume: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Evidence that residual directional flow is a repeatable execution schedule."""
    persistence = np.sign(residual.fillna(0.0)).rolling(5, min_periods=3).mean().abs()
    participation = relative_volume.rolling(5, min_periods=3).mean()
    participation_std = relative_volume.rolling(5, min_periods=3).std()
    cv = participation_std / participation.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    regularity = 1.0 / (1.0 + cv.clip(lower=0.0, upper=5.0))
    activity = participation / (1.0 + participation)
    return (persistence * regularity * activity).fillna(0.0)


def _thin_side_clock(
    close: pd.DataFrame,
    high: pd.DataFrame,
    low: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Signed first-passage volume-cost asymmetry over a trailing 14-bar path."""
    raw_range = (high - low).abs()
    range_fraction = raw_range / close.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    range_scale = range_fraction.rolling(20, min_periods=5).median().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    standardized_return = (close / close.shift(1) - 1.0) / range_scale
    standardized_return = standardized_return.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)

    median_volume = volume.rolling(20, min_periods=5).median().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    clock_volume = (volume / median_volume).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    endpoint = ((2.0 * close - high - low) / raw_range.replace(0.0, np.nan))
    endpoint = endpoint.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).clip(-1.0, 1.0).fillna(0.0)

    n_rows, n_cols = close.shape
    out = np.zeros((n_rows, n_cols), dtype=float)
    returns_array = standardized_return.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    volume_array = clock_volume.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    endpoint_array = endpoint.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    columns = np.arange(n_cols)

    for end in range(13, n_rows):
        path = np.cumsum(returns_array[end - 13 : end + 1], axis=0)
        cost = np.cumsum(volume_array[end - 13 : end + 1], axis=0)
        up_hit = path >= 1.35
        down_hit = path <= -1.35
        has_up = up_hit.any(axis=0)
        has_down = down_hit.any(axis=0)
        up_index = up_hit.argmax(axis=0)
        down_index = down_hit.argmax(axis=0)
        up_cost = np.where(has_up, cost[up_index, columns], np.nan)
        down_cost = np.where(has_down, cost[down_index, columns], np.nan)
        direction = np.sign(path[-1])
        own_cost = np.where(direction > 0.0, up_cost, down_cost)
        other_cost = np.where(direction > 0.0, down_cost, up_cost)
        asymmetry = (other_cost - own_cost) / (other_cost + own_cost)
        asymmetry = np.where(np.isfinite(asymmetry), asymmetry, 0.0)
        confirmation = np.maximum(direction * endpoint_array[end], 0.0)
        out[end] = direction * asymmetry * confirmation

    return pd.DataFrame(out, index=close.index, columns=close.columns)


@register_factor
class AuctionPeerScheduleDepletionRelay(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "auction_peer_schedule_depletion_relay"
    name = "Auction Peer Schedule Depletion Relay"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Incomplete industry-shock response after an auction repair, activated only "
        "when aligned scheduled residual flow meets fresh thin-side depletion."
    )
    window_length = 60
    inputs = ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume", "industry"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].astype(float)
        open_ = data["open"].astype(float)
        high = data["high"].astype(float)
        low = data["low"].astype(float)
        volume = data["volume"].astype(float).clip(lower=0.0).fillna(0.0)

        ret = (close / close.shift(1) - 1.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        peer, breadth = _leave_one_out_peer_return(ret, volume, data["industry"])
        auction_repair = _auction_repair_gate(open_, close, volume, peer)

        bar_range = (high - low).abs().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        candle_direction = ((close - open_) / bar_range).clip(-1.0, 1.0).fillna(0.0)
        volume_base = volume.rolling(20, min_periods=5).mean().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        relative_volume = (volume / volume_base).clip(0.0, 5.0).fillna(0.0)
        impact = ((close - close.shift(1)) / bar_range).clip(-2.0, 2.0).fillna(0.0)
        residual = (candle_direction * relative_volume - impact).clip(-5.0, 5.0)
        inventory = residual.ewm(halflife=5.0, adjust=False).mean()
        inventory_std = inventory.rolling(35, min_periods=10).std().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        inventory_z = (inventory / inventory_std).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        coherence = _schedule_coherence(residual, relative_volume)

        thin_clock = _thin_side_clock(close, high, low, volume)
        fresh_thinning = (thin_clock.abs() - thin_clock.abs().shift(1)).clip(lower=0.0)
        fresh_thinning = fresh_thinning.rolling(3, min_periods=1).max()
        aligned_schedule = (np.sign(inventory_z) == np.sign(peer)).astype(float)
        aligned_thin_side = (np.sign(thin_clock) == np.sign(peer)).astype(float)

        incomplete = (np.sign(peer) * (peer - ret)).clip(lower=0.0)
        broad_impulse = breadth.clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
        signal = (
            np.sign(peer)
            * incomplete
            * broad_impulse
            * auction_repair
            * coherence
            * fresh_thinning
            * aligned_schedule
            * aligned_thin_side
        )
        return rank(signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)).reindex(
            index=close.index, columns=close.columns
        )
programs.name: Auction Peer Schedule Depletion Relay
programs.trading_idea: An opposing opening-auction gap that repairs toward a broad industry impulse identifies a peer-information signal that was temporarily obscured by auction-specific supply or demand. The child trades that repaired peer lag only when the stock simultaneously exhibits persistent, regular residual execution in the peer direction and a fresh thin-side volume-clock crossing, indicating that dealer inventory is no longer absorbing the same directional pressure. Parent A alone cannot distinguish a harmless auction repair from imminent transmission, while Parent B alone cannot distinguish an idiosyncratic execution schedule from a transferable industry-information relay.

Positive values represent upward peer relays and negative values represent downward peer relays.

"""Cooling cancellation inventory unwind.

Mechanism: competing flow alone need not be terminal.  When unusually large
signed activity has cancelled over several days and both activity and range
subsequently cool, the episode is more likely to represent completed execution
and dealer inventory that is being unwound against the residual net pressure.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import indneutralize, rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _cooling_cancellation_state(
    close: pd.DataFrame,
    open_: pd.DataFrame,
    high: pd.DataFrame,
    low: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Return trailing net pressure and a continuous terminal-flow confidence.

    All estimators use observations at or before the current bar.  The
    confidence is deliberately continuous rather than a collection of hard
    percentile gates, reducing sensitivity to small window perturbations.
    """
    close_safe = close.replace(0.0, np.nan).ffill()
    open_safe = open_.replace(0.0, np.nan).fillna(close_safe)

    fallback_high = close_safe.where(close_safe >= open_safe, open_safe)
    fallback_low = close_safe.where(close_safe <= open_safe, open_safe)
    high_safe = high.fillna(fallback_high)
    low_safe = low.fillna(fallback_low)

    bar_range = (high_safe - low_safe).abs()
    displacement = ((close_safe - open_safe) / bar_range.replace(0.0, np.nan))
    displacement = displacement.clip(lower=-1.0, upper=1.0).fillna(0.0)

    clean_volume = volume.clip(lower=0.0).fillna(0.0)
    volume_base = clean_volume.rolling(21, min_periods=8).mean()
    relative_volume = (clean_volume / volume_base.replace(0.0, np.nan))
    relative_volume = relative_volume.clip(lower=0.0, upper=8.0).fillna(0.0)

    impulse = displacement * relative_volume
    abs_impulse = impulse.abs()
    net_pressure = impulse.rolling(9, min_periods=6).sum()
    gross_pressure = abs_impulse.rolling(9, min_periods=6).sum()
    cancellation = 1.0 - net_pressure.abs() / gross_pressure.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    cancellation = cancellation.clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0).fillna(0.0)

    gross_base = gross_pressure.rolling(55, min_periods=25).mean()
    gross_elevation = gross_pressure / gross_base.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    elevation_strength = np.tanh((gross_elevation.fillna(0.0) - 0.8).clip(lower=0.0))

    recent_activity = abs_impulse.rolling(3, min_periods=3).mean()
    prior_activity = abs_impulse.rolling(11, min_periods=7).mean()
    activity_cooling = (1.0 - recent_activity / prior_activity.replace(0.0, np.nan))
    activity_cooling = activity_cooling.clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0).fillna(0.0)

    normalized_range = bar_range / close_safe.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    recent_range = normalized_range.rolling(3, min_periods=3).mean()
    prior_range = normalized_range.rolling(11, min_periods=7).mean()
    range_compression = (1.0 - recent_range / prior_range.replace(0.0, np.nan))
    range_compression = range_compression.clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0).fillna(0.0)

    terminal_cooling = 0.5 * activity_cooling + 0.5 * range_compression
    confidence = cancellation * elevation_strength * terminal_cooling
    return net_pressure.fillna(0.0), confidence.fillna(0.0)


@register_factor
class CoolingCancellationInventoryUnwind(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "cooling_cancellation_inventory_unwind_v1"
    name = "Cooling Cancellation Inventory Unwind"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Fades sector-residual signed volume-pressure only in a continuous "
        "terminal-flow state: elevated gross activity is cancelled and then "
        "cools in both activity and range."
    )
    window_length = 70
    inputs = ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        net_pressure, confidence = _cooling_cancellation_state(
            close,
            data["open"],
            data["high"],
            data["low"],
            data["volume"],
        )
        sector = data["sector"].fillna("Unknown")
        residual_pressure = indneutralize(net_pressure, sector).fillna(0.0)

        # Higher values mean a stronger expected return opposite to the
        # residual execution direction after the episode has cooled.
        raw_signal = -residual_pressure * confidence
        return rank(raw_signal).fillna(0.5)

This child isolates the terminal phase: elevated gross signed activity must be strongly cancelled while both activity and intrabar range are cooling, indicating that the liquidity-demand episode is ending and intermediaries can begin unwinding the inventory accumulated on the net-pressure side. The edge should persist because dealer inventory and heterogeneous execution schedules are not directly observable in daily bars and unwind gradually after participation fades; it is falsified if sector-adjusted net pressure continues in its original direction specifically after this cooling-cancellation state.

Confidence rises with multi-day flow cancellation, unusual gross activity, and subsequent compression in both activity and trading range, avoiding the parent's brittle hard eligibility thresholds.

programs.code:
"""Alternating-flow reversal conditioned on a retreat in participation.

Mechanism: two-sided, cancelled bar pressure is more likely to represent
inventory transfer than information.  When abnormal participation subsequently
retreats while a residual displacement remains, the temporary impact should
unwind as inventory is redistributed.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import indneutralize, rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _flow_retreat_state(
    close: pd.DataFrame,
    open_: pd.DataFrame,
    high: pd.DataFrame,
    low: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal proxy for a completed, two-sided liquidity-demand episode."""
    open_safe = open_.fillna(close)
    upper = np.maximum(open_safe, close)
    lower = np.minimum(open_safe, close)
    high_safe = high.fillna(upper).where(high.fillna(upper) >= upper, upper)
    low_safe = low.fillna(lower).where(low.fillna(lower) <= lower, lower)
    bar_range = (high_safe - low_safe).abs().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    endpoint = ((close - open_safe) / bar_range).clip(-1.0, 1.0).fillna(0.0)

    clean_volume = volume.clip(lower=0.0).fillna(0.0)
    volume_base = clean_volume.rolling(30, min_periods=12).median().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    relative_volume = (clean_volume / volume_base).clip(0.0, 15.0).fillna(0.0)
    pressure = endpoint * np.log1p(relative_volume)

    gross = pressure.abs().rolling(11, min_periods=7).sum()
    net = pressure.rolling(11, min_periods=7).sum()
    cancellation = (1.0 - net.abs() / gross.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.0, 1.0).fillna(0.0)

    pressure_sign = np.sign(pressure)
    prior_sign = pressure_sign.shift(1)
    valid_pair = ((pressure_sign != 0.0) & (prior_sign != 0.0)).astype(float)
    sign_flip = ((pressure_sign * prior_sign) < 0.0).astype(float)
    alternating = (
        sign_flip.rolling(10, min_periods=6).sum()
        / valid_pair.rolling(10, min_periods=6).sum().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    ).clip(0.0, 1.0).fillna(0.0)

    activity = np.log1p(relative_volume)
    recent_activity = activity.rolling(3, min_periods=3).mean()
    earlier_activity = activity.shift(3).rolling(5, min_periods=4).mean()
    retreat = (
        (earlier_activity - recent_activity)
        / (earlier_activity + 0.25)
    ).clip(0.0, 1.0).fillna(0.0)
    prior_intensity = (earlier_activity / (earlier_activity + 1.0)).clip(0.0, 1.0).fillna(0.0)

    return (cancellation * alternating * retreat * prior_intensity).fillna(0.0)


@register_factor
class AlternatingFlowParticipationRetreatReversal(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "alternating_flow_participation_retreat_reversal"
    name = "Alternating Flow Participation Retreat"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Fade sector-residual short-run displacement after cancelled, alternating "
        "volume-weighted pressure when abnormal participation has subsequently retreated."
    )
    window_length = 30
    inputs = ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].replace(0.0, np.nan)
        state = _flow_retreat_state(
            close.fillna(0.0),
            data["open"],
            data["high"],
            data["low"],
            data["volume"],
        )
        short_return = close.pct_change(4).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
        sector = data["sector"].fillna("Unknown")
        residual_return = indneutralize(short_return, sector).fillna(0.0)
        reversal = -residual_return * state
        residual_reversal = indneutralize(reversal, sector).fillna(0.0)
        return (rank(residual_reversal).fillna(0.5) - 0.5).fillna(0.0)
programs.name: Alternating Flow Participation Retreat
programs.trading_idea: Alternating, strongly cancelled signed bar pressure identifies two-sided inventory transfer rather than a one-sided information event, preserving the parent’s successful distinction between mechanical and informed trading. The child adds a participation-retreat condition: a prior abnormal-volume episode followed by rapidly declining activity while the sector-residual price displacement remains unresolved indicates that the liquidity-demand shock has ended but dealer inventory and reservation prices have not yet normalized. This is falsified if sector-adjusted moves in high-cancellation episodes with sharply retreating participation continue in their original direction over the next six bars. The edge can persist because daily-bar participants observe realized volume but cannot directly observe dealer inventory, while reduced participation slows arbitrageurs’ ability to separate a fading forced-flow episode from genuinely informed quiet trading.

"""Solvency-screened forced-flow rebate.

Mechanism: downside volume in a financially resilient issuer is less likely to
reflect imminent fundamental distress and more likely to be a holder-specific
liquidity sale.  Dealers and patient capital require time to warehouse that
inventory, so the resulting concession should be repaid after the pressure
has been absorbed.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _sector_demean(values: pd.DataFrame, labels: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Remove contemporaneous sector-wide de-risking using static labels."""
    output = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=values.index, columns=values.columns)
    for _, members in labels.groupby(labels).groups.items():
        cols = [col for col in members if col in values.columns]
        if cols:
            block = values.loc[:, cols]
            output.loc[:, cols] = block.sub(block.mean(axis=1), axis=0)
    return output


def _downside_volume_pressure(close: pd.DataFrame, volume: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal smooth estimate of unusually intense downside participation."""
    ret = close.pct_change(fill_method=None).clip(-0.20, 0.20)
    downside = -ret.clip(upper=0.0)

    log_volume = np.log(volume.where(volume > 0.0))
    vol_mean = log_volume.ewm(halflife=20, adjust=False, min_periods=12).mean()
    vol_std = log_volume.ewm(halflife=20, adjust=False, min_periods=12).std()
    volume_surprise = ((log_volume - vol_mean) / vol_std.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.0, 4.0)

    daily_pressure = downside * volume_surprise
    return daily_pressure.ewm(halflife=3, adjust=False, min_periods=5).mean()


@register_factor
class SolvencyScreenedForcedFlowRebate(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "solvency_screened_forced_flow_rebate"
    name = "Solvency-Screened Forced-Flow Rebate"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Sector-relative abnormal downside return-volume pressure, continuously "
        "weighted toward issuers with high cash debt coverage and current liquidity."
    )
    window_length = 60
    inputs = ["close", "volume", "cash", "totalDebt", "currentRatio", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].replace(0.0, np.nan)
        volume = data["volume"].abs().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        cash = data["cash"].where(data["cash"] >= 0.0)
        debt = data["totalDebt"].where(data["totalDebt"] >= 0.0)
        current_ratio = data["currentRatio"].where(data["currentRatio"] > 0.0)
        labels = data["sector"].iloc[0].fillna("Unknown")

        pressure = _downside_volume_pressure(close, volume)
        idio_pressure = _sector_demean(pressure, labels).clip(lower=0.0)
        pressure_rank = rank(idio_pressure).fillna(0.5)

        cash_coverage = cash / (cash + debt).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        coverage_rank = rank(cash_coverage.clip(0.0, 1.0)).fillna(0.5)
        liquidity_rank = rank(current_ratio.clip(0.0, 10.0)).fillna(0.5)
        solvency = 0.5 * coverage_rank + 0.5 * liquidity_rank

        # Continuous conditioning avoids brittle event thresholds: selling must
        # be both unusually intense and plausibly non-informative.
        score = pressure_rank * (0.25 + 0.75 * solvency)
        return rank(score).fillna(0.5)

programs.trading_idea: Abnormal downside price-volume pressure is not uniformly informative: in firms with ample cash relative to debt and strong current liquidity, it is more likely to reflect a constrained holder's execution need than private information about impending distress. Sector-relative selling pressure in these solvent issuers therefore creates an inventory concession that patient buyers and liquidity providers unwind over the following week. The edge persists because mandate-driven sales and intermediary balance-sheet constraints cannot be arbitraged away immediately; it is falsified if high-solvency names do not outperform low-solvency names after equal sector-relative downside-volume shocks.

"""Compensator-extinction inventory markout.

Mechanism: volume-marked directional pressure is treated as a self-exciting
flow process.  When realized activity falls sharply below its exponentially
decayed conditional intensity after a coherent directional episode, the
inventory transfer is likely complete and dealer inventory can mark back.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _conditional_activity(activity: pd.DataFrame, halflife: float) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal exponentially decayed activity forecast formed only from past bars."""
    history = activity.ewm(halflife=halflife, adjust=False, min_periods=3).mean()
    decay = float(np.exp(-np.log(2.0) / halflife))
    return history.shift(1) * decay


@register_factor
class CompensatorExtinctionInventoryMarkout(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "compensator_extinction_inventory_markout"
    name = "Compensator Extinction Inventory Markout"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Fades coherent volume-marked directional displacement when current "
        "activity is unexpectedly below an exponentially decayed conditional "
        "flow intensity following an elevated burst."
    )
    window_length = 30
    inputs = ["close", "high", "low", "volume"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].replace(0.0, np.nan)
        high = data["high"].reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        low = data["low"].reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        volume = data["volume"].reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)

        bar_range = (high - low).clip(lower=0.0)
        location = 2.0 * (close - low) / bar_range.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
        location = location.clip(-1.0, 1.0).fillna(0.0)

        valid_volume = volume.where(volume > 0.0, 0.0).fillna(0.0)
        volume_baseline = valid_volume.rolling(30, min_periods=10).mean()
        relative_volume = valid_volume / volume_baseline.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        relative_volume = relative_volume.clip(lower=0.0, upper=8.0).fillna(0.0)

        signed_flow = location * relative_volume
        activity = signed_flow.abs()

        expected_activity = _conditional_activity(activity, 4.0)
        slow_activity = activity.ewm(halflife=15.0, adjust=False, min_periods=8).mean()
        burst_state = expected_activity / slow_activity.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        burst_state = burst_state.clip(lower=0.0, upper=6.0)

        extinction_surprise = (
            (expected_activity - activity).clip(lower=0.0)
            / expected_activity.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        ).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)

        cumulative_flow = signed_flow.rolling(8, min_periods=5).sum()
        cumulative_activity = activity.rolling(8, min_periods=5).sum()
        displacement = cumulative_flow / cumulative_activity.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        displacement = displacement.clip(-1.0, 1.0)

        raw_signal = -displacement * burst_state * extinction_surprise
        raw_signal = raw_signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        return rank(raw_signal).fillna(0.5)

programs.trading_idea: A persistent directional flow episode creates a self-exciting sequence of volume-marked price-pressure events; an unexpectedly quiet bar relative to the episode's exponentially decaying conditional intensity is evidence that the transfer has ended rather than merely paused. Dealers who accumulated inventory during the burst can then rebalance promptly, producing a six-bar markout opposite the preceding directional displacement. The edge persists because public daily bars reveal the extinction only after the close, while inventory holders and execution desks face balance-sheet, risk-limit, and gradual liquidation constraints rather than frictionlessly arbitraging the residual pressure.

"""Persistent low-participation session disagreement inventory repair.

Mechanism: repeated idiosyncratic overnight gaps that are opposed during quiet
intraday sessions indicate inventory transfer that has not been broadly
confirmed by participation.  The accumulated imbalance should unwind gradually
in the signed overnight-gap direction as dealers and execution traders repair
inventory over the following days.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _persistent_session_imbalance(
    close: pd.DataFrame,
    open_: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal trailing inventory-imbalance proxy built from daily sessions."""
    previous_close = close.shift(1)
    valid = (
        close.notna()
        & open_.notna()
        & previous_close.notna()
        & volume.notna()
        & (close > 0.0)
        & (open_ > 0.0)
        & (previous_close > 0.0)
        & (volume > 0.0)
    )

    overnight = np.log(open_ / previous_close).where(valid)
    intraday = np.log(close / open_).where(valid)

    # Remove the contemporaneous market-wide opening repricing component.
    idio_overnight = overnight.sub(overnight.median(axis=1), axis=0)

    daily_move = np.log(close / previous_close).abs().where(valid)
    move_scale = daily_move.rolling(20, min_periods=10).mean().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    normalized_gap = (overnight.abs() / move_scale).clip(upper=5.0)

    # Quiet counter-moves are less likely to be broad information confirmation.
    log_volume = np.log1p(volume).where(valid)
    volume_baseline = log_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=10).mean().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    quietness = (1.0 - log_volume / volume_baseline).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)

    opposed = (overnight * intraday) < 0.0
    episode = np.sign(idio_overnight) * normalized_gap * quietness
    episode = episode.where(valid & opposed, 0.0)

    # Repetition extends a transient session disagreement into a slower inventory state.
    return episode.rolling(5, min_periods=1).sum().where(valid)


@register_factor
class PersistentSessionInventoryRepair(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "persistent_session_inventory_repair"
    name = "Persistent Session Inventory Repair"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Ranks a five-session accumulation of idiosyncratic overnight gaps "
        "opposed intraday on unusually low volume, capturing slow repair of "
        "unresolved session-segmented inventory pressure."
    )
    window_length = 25
    inputs = ["open", "close", "volume"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        raw = _persistent_session_imbalance(
            data["close"], data["open"], data["volume"]
        )
        signal = rank(raw)
        return signal.where(raw.notna(), 0.0).fillna(0.0)

programs.trading_idea: A single overnight-versus-intraday disagreement is noisy and tends to resolve too quickly, but repeated idiosyncratic overnight gaps that are opposed during unusually quiet sessions indicate an unresolved inventory-transfer imbalance rather than fully incorporated information. Accumulating these episodes over several sessions creates a slower state variable: dealers and liquidity-demanding institutions must unwind the inventory over subsequent days, so returns should repair in the cumulative overnight-gap direction at the fixed six-bar horizon. This is falsified if the five-day accumulation of low-participation session disagreements does not predict six-day returns in its signed direction; the edge can persist because the state requires jointly observing repeated session segmentation and name-specific participation, while arbitrageurs face inventory and liquidity costs when attempting to front-run the unwind.

"""Operational diffusion released by opposed auction inventory pressure.

Mechanism: coherent improvements in gross margin and cash conversion are credible
operational-state changes, but they diffuse slowly when their initial price response is
muted.  A confirmed, partially refilled auction gap in the opposite direction is treated
as transient execution/inventory pressure: its empirically contrarian completion releases
price toward the operational information rather than invalidating the update.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _sector_residual_return(close: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal daily return net of contemporaneous static-sector mean."""
    ret = close.replace(0.0, np.nan).pct_change(fill_method=None).clip(-0.30, 0.30)
    labels = sector.ffill().iloc[-1].fillna("Unknown").astype(str)
    sector_mean = ret.T.groupby(labels, sort=False).transform("mean").T
    return ret - sector_mean


def _confirmed_auction_score(
    open_price: pd.DataFrame,
    close_price: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
    volume_window: int,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Signed causal auction-refill score confirmed through the current close."""
    prior_close = close_price.shift(1).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    gap = (open_price - prior_close) / prior_close
    intraday_move = (close_price - open_price) / open_price.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    refill = (-intraday_move / gap.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.5)

    base_volume = volume.shift(1).rolling(volume_window, min_periods=volume_window).mean()
    abnormal_volume = (volume / base_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(lower=0.0)
    activity = np.log1p(abnormal_volume).clip(upper=3.0)

    event_gap = gap.shift(2)
    event_refill = refill.shift(2)
    event_activity = activity.shift(2)
    event_reference = prior_close.shift(2)
    direction = np.sign(event_gap)
    gap_size = event_gap.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan)

    retain_one = direction * (close_price.shift(1) / event_reference - 1.0)
    retain_two = direction * (close_price / event_reference - 1.0)
    retained = ((retain_one + retain_two) / 2.0 / gap_size).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.5)
    return (event_gap * event_refill * event_activity * retained).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)


@register_factor
class OperationalAuctionOppositionRelease(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "operational_auction_opposition_release"
    name = "Operational Auction Opposition Release"
    category = "sentiment"
    description = (
        "Muted coherent margin/cash-cycle updates conditioned on an opposed, "
        "high-volume confirmed auction-refill imbalance that is likely to reverse."
    )
    window_length = 22
    inputs = ["open", "close", "volume", "grossMargin", "cashConversionCycle", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].replace(0.0, np.nan)
        margin = data["grossMargin"]
        cash_cycle = data["cashConversionCycle"]

        prior_margin = margin.shift(1)
        prior_cycle = cash_cycle.shift(1)
        joint_update = (
            margin.notna() & prior_margin.notna() & margin.ne(prior_margin)
            & cash_cycle.notna() & prior_cycle.notna() & cash_cycle.ne(prior_cycle)
        )

        margin_change = (margin - prior_margin).clip(-0.50, 0.50)
        cycle_improvement = (prior_cycle - cash_cycle).clip(-365.0, 365.0)
        operational = 0.5 * (
            rank(margin_change.where(joint_update)) - 0.5
            + rank(cycle_improvement.where(joint_update)) - 0.5
        )

        idio_ret = _sector_residual_return(close, data["sector"])
        response = idio_ret.rolling(3, min_periods=2).sum()
        response_vol = idio_ret.rolling(20, min_periods=10).std()
        response_z = response / (response_vol * np.sqrt(3.0)).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        signed_response = np.sign(operational) * response_z
        muted_weight = np.exp(-signed_response.clip(lower=0.0, upper=3.0))

        auction = _confirmed_auction_score(
            data["open"].replace(0.0, np.nan),
            close,
            data["volume"].fillna(0.0).clip(lower=0.0),
            20,
        )
        opposed = (operational * auction) < 0.0
        auction_strength = rank(auction.abs())

        raw = (operational * muted_weight * auction_strength).where(joint_update & opposed)
        return rank(raw).fillna(0.0)

The auction parent’s realized negative sign suggests that a retained, partially refilled gap more often marks temporary inventory completion and subsequent reversal than persistent informed continuation; conditioning on an auction signal opposed to the operational update isolates cases where short-horizon execution pressure is pushing price away from a credible fundamental transition. The interaction carries edge because the operational state determines the economically justified reversal direction, while the confirmed auction state distinguishes a merely unpriced update from one actively displaced by transient liquidity demand or supply.

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _decayed_state(impulse: pd.DataFrame, decay: float) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal exponentially decayed state of sparse information impulses."""
    values = impulse.fillna(0.0).to_numpy(dtype=float, copy=True)
    rows, cols = values.shape
    output = np.zeros((rows, cols), dtype=float)
    state = np.zeros(cols, dtype=float)
    for row in range(rows):
        state = decay * state + values[row]
        output[row] = state
    return pd.DataFrame(output, index=impulse.index, columns=impulse.columns)


def _group_sum(values: pd.DataFrame, labels: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
    grouped = values.T.groupby(labels, sort=False).sum().T
    mapped = grouped.reindex(columns=labels.to_numpy())
    mapped.columns = values.columns
    return mapped


def _peer_state(
    returns_frame: pd.DataFrame, labels: pd.Series
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Leave-one-out peer return and directional breadth, both contemporaneous and causal."""
    valid = returns_frame.notna().astype(float)
    clean = returns_frame.fillna(0.0)
    total_return = _group_sum(clean, labels)
    total_count = _group_sum(valid, labels)
    peer_count = total_count - valid
    peer_return = (total_return - clean).div(peer_count.replace(0.0, np.nan))

    peer_sign = np.sign(peer_return)
    aligned = (
        (np.sign(clean) == peer_sign)
        & (peer_sign != 0.0)
        & returns_frame.notna()
    ).astype(float)
    aligned_total = _group_sum(aligned, labels)
    breadth = (aligned_total - aligned).div(peer_count.replace(0.0, np.nan))
    return peer_return.where(peer_count >= 3.0), breadth.where(peer_count >= 3.0)


def _scaled_revision(level: pd.DataFrame, window: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Scale a point-in-time estimate change by its own trailing level scale."""
    x = level.astype(float)
    scale = x.abs().rolling(window, min_periods=20).median().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return (x.diff() / scale).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)


@register_factor
class RevisionAnchoredAuctionOppositionRelease(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "revision_anchored_auction_opposition_release"
    name = "Revision-Anchored Auction Opposition Release"
    category = "momentum"
    description = (
        "Ranks recent consensus revisions corroborated by broad industry returns "
        "when persistent abnormal-volume closing pressure runs in the opposite "
        "direction, indicating temporary execution flow blocking assimilation."
    )
    window_length = 126
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "high",
        "low",
        "volume",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueEstimate",
        "industry",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].astype(float)
        if close.empty:
            return close.astype(float)

        high = data["high"].reindex_like(close).astype(float)
        low = data["low"].reindex_like(close).astype(float)
        volume = data["volume"].reindex_like(close).astype(float)

        industry_frame = data["industry"].reindex_like(close)
        raw_labels = industry_frame.iloc[0].copy()
        fallback = pd.Series(
            ["__unknown_" + str(column) for column in close.columns],
            index=close.columns,
            dtype=object,
        )
        labels = raw_labels.where(raw_labels.notna(), fallback).astype(str)

        eps_revision = _scaled_revision(
            data["epsEstimate"].reindex_like(close), 126
        )
        revenue_revision = _scaled_revision(
            data["revenueEstimate"].reindex_like(close), 126
        )
        revision_impulse = (
            0.7 * eps_revision.fillna(0.0)
            + 0.3 * revenue_revision.fillna(0.0)
        ).clip(-2.0, 2.0)
        revision_state = _decayed_state(revision_impulse, 0.90)
        direction = np.sign(revision_state)
        recent_revision = (
            revision_impulse.abs().rolling(15, min_periods=1).max() > 0.0
        )

        bar_range = (high - low).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        close_location = ((2.0 * close - high - low) / bar_range).clip(-1.0, 1.0)
        volume_base = volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=10).median()
        volume_ratio = volume.div(volume_base.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        volume_surprise = np.log(volume_ratio).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        confidence = volume_surprise.clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.5)
        auction_impulse = (close_location * confidence).fillna(0.0)
        auction_state = _decayed_state(auction_impulse, 0.85)
        auction_scale = auction_state.shift(1).rolling(40, min_periods=15).std()
        auction_z = auction_state.div(auction_scale.replace(0.0, np.nan))

        stock_return = close.pct_change(fill_method=None)
        peer_return, peer_breadth = _peer_state(stock_return, labels)
        trailing_vol = stock_return.rolling(21, min_periods=10).std().shift(1)
        peer_strength = (
            peer_return.abs().div(trailing_vol.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.0, 3.0) / 3.0
        ).fillna(0.0)
        broad_coherence = ((peer_breadth - 0.5) / 0.5).clip(0.0, 1.0).fillna(0.0)
        revision_peer_agreement = (direction * np.sign(peer_return)).clip(0.0, 1.0)

        opposition = (-direction * auction_z).clip(0.0, 3.0).fillna(0.0) / 3.0
        revision_magnitude = rank(revision_state.abs()).fillna(0.5)
        gate = peer_strength * broad_coherence * revision_peer_agreement * opposition
        raw_signal = direction * revision_magnitude * gate
        active = recent_revision & (direction != 0.0) & (gate > 0.0)

        signal = rank(raw_signal.where(active))
        return signal.where(active, 0.5).reindex_like(close).astype(float).fillna(0.5)
